steps.subject: sky
steps.action: block in phthalo blue sky
steps.load: tap a little color into bristles
steps.motion: push color across the upper sky

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: add darker prussian blue to corners
steps.load: add prussian blue on the same brush

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: darken corners with midnight black
steps.load: add a little midnight black

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: lay in a light area at the top
steps.load: tap white on the brush after washing
steps.rule: marks the lightest area as the light source

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: tap basic bush and tree shapes
steps.load: tap prussian blue onto bristles

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: add yellow and ochre highlights
steps.load: pick up cad yellow and ochre on the same brush
steps.rule: leftover blue turns the yellow green

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: tap in tree trunks and limbs
steps.load: thin the dark mix with thinner

steps.subject: land
steps.action: block in green and yellow background
steps.load: pick up greens and yellows

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: scrape a basic barn shape
steps.rule: scraping a shape helps me plan placement and perspective

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: block in barn color with knife
steps.load: load van dyke brown on the knife

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: pull marbled colors down the barn
steps.load: roll a marbled load on the knife
steps.rule: marbled mix gives variation instead of one flat color

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: darken one barn side and add board marks
steps.load: roll more paint on the knife
steps.motion: touch and let it pull off

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: mix and bounce roof color with knife
steps.load: mix colors without over-mixing
steps.motion: bounce the knife on the roof
steps.rule: not over-mixing keeps the varied colors

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: sparkle barn edge with blue-white
steps.load: cut a very small roll of paint
steps.rule: sparkle the edge so it stands out

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: add board marks on barn
steps.load: touch the knife lightly with paint
steps.rule: so it looks made from old boards

steps.subject: grass
steps.action: tap grassy areas along the bottom
steps.load: tap greens and yellows, touch of bright red
steps.motion: tap in a few grassy shapes
steps.rule: red dulls greens, since green and red make brown

steps.subject: land
steps.action: tap a hill sloping down
steps.load: add a little thinner

steps.subject: path
steps.action: lay in brown path with crimson end
steps.load: mix sienna into the brown, add crimson at one end
steps.motion: pull path out through the grass
steps.rule: crimson will show under the later highlight

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: paint a big tree trunk with arms
steps.load: mix brown and sienna on the fan brush

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: add broken limbs hanging from the bottom
steps.load: same mix on bristles
steps.motion: touch and give a little pull
steps.rule: crooked limbs with character look more interesting

steps.subject: fence
steps.action: add a couple of fence posts
steps.load: mix a lighter brown
steps.rule: must be brighter or the post will not show

steps.subject: fence
steps.action: cut in a thin wire line
steps.load: thin brown on the liner brush

steps.subject: grass
steps.action: tap grass around the fence and path
steps.load: pick up greens and yellows
steps.motion: tap grass at the foot of posts
